notes.title: Update 8/8/2023
notes.content:
This is a small update to correct a couple of small bugs. 
- Fixed spacing of columns in the leaderboards (for positions >99)
- Tweaked the phrasing in a couple of spanish translations to make the shorter
- Added a checkpoint to Kingsdown to prevent track-cutting

notes.title: New content update brings the total to 30 tracks and 67 cars!
notes.content:
New track: This is the 30th track that comes to the game, and its one of my favorite ones: Mount Panorama!
New cars: Formula Pretend received three new liveries inspired in classic cars
New sounds: crowd sounds were completely redone to make them more natural and less repetitive

notes.title: New track, cars and added support for languages!
notes.content:
New track: with the addition of South Africa, PCR has at least a track for every continent!
 New cars: Formula Pretend adds two classic liveries
 Support for languages: you can now choose to play in English or Spanish
 Added a checkpoint in Buenos Aires to avoid track-cutting
 Improved game mode graphics in the menus

notes.title: New track, new cars and UX improvements
notes.content:
New track: You can now fight for the top positions in the leaderboard in Buenos Aires!
 New cars: Two new german contenders for the Classics category
 Mini-map: Tweaked the display information and now all cars positions are drawn in the mini-map
 Improved overlays: better legibility and more information shown when completing a lap (current position and laps are shown next to your car). Shortened the text shown when doing a lap record for faster reading.
 New guardrails: Buenos Aires is the first track using a new method for placing guardrails, after further testing, other tracks will get this upgrade.
